title: Vanished at Sea: The Ghost Ships No One Can Explain

scenes.text: In 1872 the Mary Celeste was found adrift, sails set, not a soul aboard.
The captain's log stopped ten days before she was found — mid-sentence.
The lifeboat was gone. The cargo was untouched. The food was still on the table.
No storm was recorded. No pirates. No bodies ever surfaced.
Decades later, the Carroll A. Deering ran aground with the same eerie silence.
A meal sat half-eaten in the galley. The crew had simply vanished.
Investigators blamed mutiny, then piracy, then gave up entirely.
To this day, the sea keeps its ships — and its secrets.
